usedFor: Contact Form 7 collects enquiries, and Google Contacts stores each sender through “Create Contact” after a “New Form Submission”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Form Submission” in Contact Form 7, then “Create Contact” in Google Contacts
bestTemplate.why: Every enquiry becomes a saved contact the moment the form is sent, with no copying from an inbox.

watchOut: A repeat sender runs “Create Contact” again, while “Update Contact” merges new details into the existing record.
